semantics.behavior: Combinational byte split: out_hi is input bits 15 through 8; out_lo is input bits 7 through 0.
semantics.latency: No clock or cycle latency; sample after combinational settling.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior specified.
semantics.initialization: No stored state or specified initialization; outputs follow input, including unknown bits.
semantics.evidence: Original problem explicitly specifies a combinational circuit splitting [15:0] into lower [7:0] and upper [15:8].

numeric.arithmetic: None; no signed interpretation or truncation beyond selecting each byte.

verification.oracle: Independently calculate high byte by integer division by 256 and low byte by remainder modulo 256 for all binary inputs.
verification.coverage: Directed zero, all ones, byte boundaries, alternating patterns; exhaustive 65536 binary values; selected X/Z propagation checks.
verification.sampling: Drive input then wait 1 ns before checking combinational outputs.
verification.failure: $fatal on any mismatch or bounded timeout; PASS only after all checks.
